# secureaccess_threat_category (Data Source)

This data source reads a Threat Category, found by its `id` or by its `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_threat_category" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `name` (String) Name of the Threat Category.

### Read-Only

- `amp_scan` (Boolean) Specifies whether AMP scan is enabled.
- `botnet_protection` (Boolean) Specifies whether botnet protection is enabled.
- `bundle_type_id` (Number) ID of the bundle type of the Threat Category.
- `file_inspection` (Boolean) Specifies whether file inspection is enabled.
- `ip_filtering` (Boolean) Specifies whether IP filtering is enabled.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Specifies whether this is the default Threat Category.
- `is_swg_default` (Boolean) Specifies whether this is the default Threat Category for the secure web gateway (SWG). The API returns null if it is not set, which is read as `false`.
- `malware_protection` (Boolean) Specifies whether malware protection is enabled.
- `malware_url_proxy` (Boolean) Specifies whether the malware URL proxy is enabled.
- `phishing_protection` (Boolean) Specifies whether phishing protection is enabled.
- `super_botnet` (Boolean) Specifies whether super botnet is enabled.
- `super_malware` (Boolean) Specifies whether super malware is enabled.
- `suspicious_response_filtering` (Boolean) Specifies whether suspicious response filtering is enabled.
- `url_proxy_https` (Boolean) Specifies whether URL proxy HTTPS is enabled.
